title: YouTube sports strategy targets more live rights -- but not necessarily events
summary: YouTube is intensifying its focus on acquiring live sports rights, aiming to enhance its offerings in this competitive market. However, the platform is more inclined to purchase games in bulk, provided there is a compelling consumer proposition associated with these rights. This strategic approach reflects YouTube's desire to create a more engaging and valuable experience for its audience, rather than simply amassing a collection of events.
